canonical_project: Gibtelecom Data Centre / Rockolo Mount Pleasant
notes: Gibtelecom owns and operates a data centre at Mount Pleasant (25 South Barrack Road) hosting third-party servers; GRA annual reports and 2025 Privy Council case summary (GibFibre v GRA) confirm the Mount Pleasant facility; GibFibre has pursued access to it through GRA/Supreme Court/Court of Appeal proceedings. Tier III per DataMove/industry listings; capacity not publicly disclosed.
